regulation by symbiont of host cell motility
related: modulation by symbiont of host cell movement

definition: A process in which a symbiont alters or subverts cell motility in its host organism. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host cell motility
